payload.reason: The evidence provides specific details about previously reported results in speculation detection tasks, including improvements in F1 scores and model performance comparisons.

claims.text: Substantial improvements over previously reported results were achieved, with at least 0.29 F1 points on cue detection and 4.27 F1 points on scope resolution.
XLNet consistently outperformed BERT and RoBERTa in the context of speculation detection, which contrasts with results on other benchmark datasets.
